# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user.

# Single-cell analysis - Tcell classification

Here, we will perform the third single cell analysis steps, including Tcell phenotyping.

## Read in data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")
sce

# 392162  cells
```

remove two low quality images
```{r}
sce <- sce[, sce$sample_id != "ZTMA20.1_Block3_SE_085"] # a lot of unspecific binding from different markers
sce <- sce[, sce$sample_id != "ZTMA224.1_BlockB_SE_129"] # cropped
sce
# 392060  cells
```

# Filter sce for T cells

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
sce <- sce[,sce$immune_metacluster %in% c("CD4_T_cell","CD8_T_cell")]

sce
# 111317  cells
```

## add min_max based on T cells

```{r}
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "exprs") - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs"))
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "min_max") / (rowMaxs(assay(sce, "exprs")) - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs")))
```


## Define T cell markers

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
# don't include 4-1BB since it's not used for clustering
rowData(sce)$Tcell_markers <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD8a","CD4","CD45RA",                            
                                                     "LAG-3", "Tim-3", "CD279", "NKG2A", "CXCL13",
                                                     "EOMES", "Tbet", "FOXP3", "GATA3",                          
                                                     "GITR", "CD134", "CD278",
                                                     "GranB", "GranK")

rowData(sce)$Tcell_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD45RA",    # without CD4 and CD8a
                                                     "LAG-3", "Tim-3", "CD279", "NKG2A", "CXCL13",
                                                     "EOMES", "Tbet", "FOXP3", "GATA3",                          
                                                     "GITR", "CD134", "CD278",
                                                     "GranB", "GranK")

rowData(sce)$CD4_CD8 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD8a","CD4", "CD3")
```



## View marker expression on images

extract images

```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/masks_ccRCC")
```


extract sample_id from images with a lot of low abundant marker expression

```{r}
markers <- c("GranB", "GranK", "LAG-3", "Tim-3", "CD279", "NKG2A","CD134", "GITR", "CD278", "4-1BB", "GATA3", "Tbet", "EOMES", "FOXP3", "IRF4", "CD73", "TMEM173", "Ki67")

sample_id <- c()

# based on max mean marker expression
for (marker in markers){
  marker_exprs <- assay(sce, "exprs")[marker,] %>% as.data.frame()
  marker_exprs$cell_id <- rownames(marker_exprs)
  colnames(marker_exprs) <- c("exprs", "cell_id")
  marker_exprs$sample_id <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", marker_exprs$cell_id)
  top5_samples <- marker_exprs %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% summarise(meanExprs = mean(exprs)) %>% arrange(desc(meanExprs)) %>% head(5) %>% pull(sample_id)
  sample_id <- c(sample_id, top5_samples)
}

markers <- c("GranB", "GranK", "LAG-3", "Tim-3", "CD279", "NKG2A","CD134", "GITR", "CD278", "4-1BB", "GATA3", "Tbet", "EOMES", "FOXP3", "IRF4", "CD73", "TMEM173", "Ki67")

sample_id <- c()

# based on max tot marker expression
for (marker in markers){
  marker_exprs <- assay(sce, "exprs")[marker,] %>% as.data.frame()
  marker_exprs$cell_id <- rownames(marker_exprs)
  colnames(marker_exprs) <- c("exprs", "cell_id")
  marker_exprs$sample_id <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", marker_exprs$cell_id)
  top5_samples <- marker_exprs %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% summarise(tot = sum(exprs)) %>% arrange(desc()) %>% head(5) %>% pull(sample_id)
  sample_id <- c(sample_id, top5_samples)
}

```

### cytomapper
```{r}
markers <- c("GranB", "GranK", "LAG-3", "Tim-3", "CD279", "NKG2A","CD134", "GITR", "CD278", "4-1BB", "GATA3", "Tbet", "EOMES", "FOXP3", "IRF4", "CD73", "TMEM173", "Ki67")


counter <- 0
for (i in seq(from = 1, to = length(sample_id), by = 5)){
  counter <- counter + 1
  marker <- markers[counter]
  cur_sample <- sample_id[i:(i+4)]
  cur_images <- images[mcols(images)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
  cur_masks <- masks[mcols(masks)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
  cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
  
  # Prepare images
  cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, separateImages = TRUE)
  cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))
  
  plotPixels(cur_images,
           mask = cur_masks,
           object = cur_sce,
           img_id = "sample_id",
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
           missing_colour = "white",
           colour_by = marker,
           outline_by = "immune_metacluster",
           colour = list(marker=c("black", "cyan")),
           thick = FALSE,
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7),
           save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/06_Tcell/", marker, "_expression.png"), scale = 2)
  )
}

```

### CD4 clustering

Decided for following clustering
```{r cluster, message=FALSE}
library(Rphenoannoy)
set.seed(22)

#k=70
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 70)

CD4_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce4$CD4_cluster_70 <- CD4_clusters

unique(sce4$CD4_cluster_70)

gc()


#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce4, "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_06_ccRCC_CD4.rds")
```

## Cluster Stability

#### CD8
```{r clustree, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]

CD8_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce8))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce8)),"CD8_cluster_[:digit:]")]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(CD8_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce8)[,CD8_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce8, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce8)[,CD8_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce8, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce8)[,CD8_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(CD8_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,3]), # change
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "CD8_cluster")
}

df_out <- df

p_nclus_CD8 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x = k, y = num_clus)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_line(color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_rmsd_FS_CD8 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x = k, y = rmsd)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_line(color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "cluster size", y = "RMSD") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_sil_FS_CD8 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x = k, y = sil)) +
  geom_point(aes(k, sil), size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(k, sil), color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "cluster size", y = "silhouette width") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
p_nclus_CD8+p_rmsd_FS_CD8+p_sil_FS_CD8

# chose CD8_cluster_130
```

Save Figure as PDF
```{r}
# Define the desired ratio in cm
width_ratio <- 30
height_ratio <- 20

width_cm <- width_ratio * scale

p_nclus_CD8
```

# 2. Astir for automated cell type assignment 

### Astir model

see [here](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2405471221003355?via%3Dihub) for full publication (Geuenich et al.,2021, Cell Systems).

CD4: Uncertainty Threshold of 0.75 used. (Because a lot of cells across different clusters were assigned as Activated with lower uncertainty threshold)
CD8:Uncertainty Threshold of 0.5 used.

```{r astir-expo}
#Export min_max normalized expression matrix as csv
# CD4
exprs_astir_CD4 <- assay(sce4,"exprs") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(PID = sce4$PID)

write.csv(exprs_astir_CD4, file = "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/06_Tcell/Astir/exprs_ccRCC_CD4_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)

# CD8
#Export min_max normalized expression matrix as csv
exprs_astir_CD8 <- assay(sce8,"exprs") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(PID = sce8$PID)

write.csv(exprs_astir_CD8, file = "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/06_Tcell/Astir/exprs_ccRCC_CD8_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

`Next: Run Astir in Python.`

# 3. GMM 
#### CD8

```{r GMM-threshold, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# min_max
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 20)
type_markers <- c("CD45RA", "Tim-3", "CD279", "NKG2A", "EOMES", "Tbet", "CD134", "GranB", "GranK", "CXCL13") # don't include LAG-3
rowData(sce8)$GMM_CD8 <- rownames(sce8) %in% type_markers

# paste TRUE for pos and FALSE for neg

out_list <- foreach (x = type_markers) %dopar%{ 
  
  GMM_marker <- Mclust(assay(sce8, "exprs")[x,], G = 2)
  GMM_df <- data.frame(class_marker = ifelse(GMM_marker$classification == 2 & GMM_marker$uncertainty < 0.01, paste0(TRUE), paste0(FALSE)), # better results with < 0.01
                     marker_exprs = assay(sce8, "exprs")[x,],
                     uncertainty = GMM_marker$uncertainty)
  
  return(class_marker = GMM_df$class_marker)
}


for (i in seq_along(out_list)){
  colData(sce8)[,paste0(type_markers[i],"_GMM")] <- out_list[[i]]
}


# change columns with "-"
sce8$Tim3_GMM <- sce8$`Tim-3_GMM`
sce8$`Tim-3_GMM` <- NULL
```

GMM combined
```{r}
# define broad categories
data_dt <- colData(sce8) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select("CD45RA_GMM", "Tim3_GMM", "CD279_GMM", "NKG2A_GMM", "EOMES_GMM", "Tbet_GMM", "CD134_GMM", "GranB_GMM", "GranK_GMM", "CXCL13_GMM")

data_numeric <- data_dt %>% #column_to_rownames("cell_id") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(str_detect(., "TRUE"))))

data_numeric_out <- data_numeric %>%
  # add combined categories
  mutate(Exhausted_GMM = ifelse((Tim3_GMM | CD279_GMM | CXCL13_GMM) & !GranB_GMM & !GranK_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% #at least one of the exhaustion markers must be present but no cytotoxic (don't include CXCl13)
  mutate(Cytotoxic_GMM = ifelse((GranB_GMM | GranK_GMM) & !Tim3_GMM & !CD279_GMM & !CXCL13_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% #at least one of the cytotoxic markers must be present but no exhaustion marker
  mutate(Exhausted_cytotoxic_GMM = ifelse((GranB_GMM | GranK_GMM) & (Tim3_GMM | CD279_GMM), 1, 0)) %>% # at least one of both cytotoxic markers and one of the exhausiton markers must be present
  mutate(CXCL13_only_GMM = ifelse(CXCL13_GMM & !CD279_GMM & !Tim3_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # cells only expressing CXCé13 and no exhaustion markers
  
  # deselect
  dplyr::select(-Tim3_GMM, -CD279_GMM, -GranB_GMM, -GranK_GMM, -CXCL13_GMM) %>% 
  
  # sum
  mutate(sum = rowSums(.)) %>% filter(sum == 1) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:10, names_to = "GMM", values_to = "count") %>% 
  filter(count == 1) %>% dplyr::select(GMM, cell_id)


# rename
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD45RA_GMM"] <- "CD45RA"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Exhausted_GMM"] <- "Exhausted"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "NKG2A_GMM"] <- "NKG2A"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Cytotoxic_GMM"] <- "Cytotoxic"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Exhausted_cytotoxic_GMM"] <- "Exhausted_cytotoxic"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Tbet_GMM"] <- "Tbet"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "EOMES_GMM"] <- "EOMES"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD134_GMM"] <- "CD134"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CXCL13_only_GMM"] <- "CXCL13"


# add to sce
sce8$GMM_CD8_combined <- data_numeric_out$GMM[match(sce8$cell_id, data_numeric_out$cell_id)]

sce8$GMM_CD8_combined[is.na(sce8$GMM_CD8_combined)] <- "Undefined"
```

```{r GMM-threshold, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# on exprs
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 20)
type_markers <- c("CD45RA", "Tim-3", "CD279", "NKG2A", "Tbet", "FOXP3", "EOMES", "GITR", "CD134", "CD278", "CXCL13")
rowData(sce4)$GMM_CD4 <- rownames(sce4) %in% type_markers

# paste TRUE for pos and FALSE for neg

out_list <- foreach (x = type_markers) %dopar%{ 
  
  GMM_marker <- Mclust(assay(sce4, "exprs")[x,], G = 2)
  GMM_df <- data.frame(class_marker = ifelse(GMM_marker$classification == 2 & GMM_marker$uncertainty < 0.01, paste0(TRUE), paste0(FALSE)), 
                     marker_exprs = assay(sce4, "exprs")[x,],
                     uncertainty = GMM_marker$uncertainty)
  
  return(class_marker = GMM_df$class_marker)
}


for (i in seq_along(out_list)){
  colData(sce4)[,paste0(type_markers[i],"_GMM")] <- out_list[[i]]
}


# change columns with "-"

sce4$`Tim-3_GMM` <- NULL
```

GMM combined
```{r}
# define broad categories
data_dt <- colData(sce4) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select("CD45RA_GMM", "Tim3_GMM", "CD279_GMM", "NKG2A_GMM", "EOMES_GMM", "Tbet_GMM", "CD134_GMM", "CXCL13_GMM", "FOXP3_GMM", "GITR_GMM", "CD278_GMM")

data_numeric <- data_dt %>% #column_to_rownames("cell_id") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(str_detect(., "TRUE"))))

data_numeric_out <- data_numeric %>% 
  # add combined categories
  mutate(Exhausted_GMM = ifelse(Tim3_GMM | CD279_GMM , 1, 0)) %>% # exhausted if one or multiple of the markers are present 
  mutate(Treg_GMM = ifelse((FOXP3_GMM & CD278_GMM) | FOXP3_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # Treg if FOXP3 and CD278 positive or only FOXP3
  mutate(Activated_GMM = ifelse(GITR_GMM | (CD278_GMM & !FOXP3_GMM) | CD134_GMM, 1, 0)) %>%

  # delselect
  dplyr::select(-Tim3_GMM, -CD279_GMM, -FOXP3_GMM, -CD278_GMM, -GITR_GMM, -CD134_GMM) %>% 
  
  # sum
  mutate(sum = rowSums(.)) %>% filter(sum == 1) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:9, names_to = "GMM", values_to = "count") %>% 
  filter(count == 1) %>% dplyr::select(cell_id, GMM)

data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD45RA_GMM"] <- "CD45RA"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Exhausted_GMM"] <- "Exhausted"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "NKG2A_GMM"] <- "NKG2A"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Treg_GMM"] <- "Treg"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Tbet_GMM"] <- "Tbet"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "EOMES_GMM"] <- "EOMES"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "Activated_GMM"] <- "Activated"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CXCL13_GMM"] <- "CXCL13" # add CXCL13 as a different category and don't add to "Exhausted_GMM"



sce4$GMM_CD4_combined <- data_numeric_out$GMM[match(sce4$cell_id, data_numeric_out$cell_id)]

sce4$GMM_CD4_combined[is.na(sce4$GMM_CD4_combined)] <- "Undefined"
```

### CD4 Metacluster

```{r}
sce4 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_06_ccRCC_CD4.rds")
```


#### Complex heatmap and metacluster assignment

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
### 1. Heatmap body ###

# select cluster
sce4$cluster_selected <- sce4$CD4_cluster_70  # adjust

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce4 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce4, ids = sce4$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce4)$CD4_cluster)  

# CD8-CD4 Markers - Aggregrate across cells with the mean 
mean_CD4_CD8 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce4, ids = sce4$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce4)$CD4_CD8)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce4) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% dplyr::select(-cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster_selected = spatial$cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce4)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce4)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce4)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce4)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce4)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce4)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

## 2.2 Astir/GMM prediction

# Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sce4) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,astir_CD4_combined) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = astir_CD4_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

astir_anno_df <- astir_anno%>%as.data.frame()
max_marker_astir <- apply(astir_anno_df, 1, function(x) names(astir_anno_df)[which.max(x)])


# #Create colors for astir cell types
astir_col <- setNames(c("#ffcd6d", "#b1ffd2" , "#e2f8ff", "#b2fcff" ,"#007a8a", "#c283b5", "#ff9dca", "#CAB2D6"), c("CXCL13", "CD45RA", "Tbet", "Treg", "NKG2A","Exhausted" , "Activated","Undefined"))


metadata(sce4)$colors$astir_col <- astir_col
metadata(sce4)$colors$astir_col <- metadata(sce4)$colors$astir_col[match(colnames(astir_anno),names(metadata(sce4)$colors$astir_col))]


## GMM cell types per cluster
GMM_anno <- colData(sce4) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,GMM_CD4_combined) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = GMM_CD4_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")


# #Create colors for GMM cell types
GMM_col <- setNames(c("#ffcd6d", "#b1ffd2" , "#e2f8ff", "#b2fcff" ,"#007a8a", "#c283b5", "#ff9dca", "#CAB2D6"), c("CXCL13", "CD45RA", "Tbet", "Treg", "NKG2A","Exhausted" , "Activated","Undefined"))

metadata(sce4)$colors$GMM_col <- GMM_col
metadata(sce4)$colors$GMM_col <- metadata(sce4)$colors$GMM_col[match(colnames(GMM_anno),names(metadata(sce4)$colors$GMM_col))]

## 2.3 DP T cell Proportion

DP_anno <- colData(sce4)%>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% summarise(tot_cells=n())

DP_anno$n_DP<- colData(sce4)%>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(Tcell_assignment, cluster_selected) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% filter(Tcell_assignment=="double_positive")%>%summarise(tot_DP=n())%>% pull(tot_DP)

DP_anno <- DP_anno %>% mutate(fra_DP = n_DP/tot_cells) %>% dplyr::select(-n_DP, -tot_cells, -cluster_selected) %>% as.data.frame()


ha_astir_GMM <- HeatmapAnnotation(

  mutate(metacluster = ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("4", "8", "10", "11", "14"), "Exhausted-like",
                              ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("3", "7"), "Naive-like",

        name = "min_max",
```

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across metacluster with the mean
mean_sce4 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce4, ids = sce4$CD4_metacluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce4)$CD4_cluster)  

# CD8-CD4 Markers - Aggregrate across cells with the mean 
mean_CD4_CD8 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce4, ids = sce4$CD4_metacluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce4)$CD4_CD8)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce4) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, CD4_metacluster)
spatial <- spatial %>% dplyr::select(-CD4_metacluster) %>% aggregate(by = list(CD4_metacluster = spatial$CD4_metacluster), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("CD4_metacluster")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce4)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce4)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce4)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce4)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce4)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce4)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row",
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15))
```

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
### 1. Heatmap body ###

sce8$cluster_selected <- sce8$CD8_cluster_130  # adjust

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce8 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce8, ids = sce8$cluster_selected,

# Heatmap aside for CD4 & CD8 - Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_CD4_CD8 <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce8, ids = sce8$cluster_selected,

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce8) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% dplyr::select(-cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster_selected = spatial$cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce8)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce8)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce8)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce8)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce8)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce8)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir/GMM prediction 

# Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sce8) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,astir_CD8_combined) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = astir_CD8_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Create colors for astir cell types
astir_col <- setNames(c("#ffcd6d", "#b1ffd2" , "#e2f8ff", "#c3e6fc", "#b2fcff" ,"#007a8a", "#006bff","#c283b5", "#9975ba","#ff9dca", "#CAB2D6"), c("CXCL13", "CD45RA", "Tbet", "EOMES","Treg", "NKG2A", "Cytotoxic","Exhausted" , "Exhausted_cytotoxic", "CD134","Undefined"))

metadata(sce8)$colors$astir_col <- astir_col
metadata(sce8)$colors$astir_col <- metadata(sce8)$colors$astir_col[match(colnames(astir_anno),names(metadata(sce8)$colors$astir_col))]


# GMM cell types per cluster

tot_DP <- colData(sce8)%>% as.data.frame %>% filter(Tcell_assignment=="double_positive")%>%summarise(tot_DP=n())%>% pull(tot_DP)
```

```{r}
sce8 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_06_ccRCC_CD8.rds")
```

```{r}
sce_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cell_id)
colnames(sce_df) <- "cell_id"

CD4_subset <- tibble(cell_id = sce4$cell_id, 
                     CD4_metacluster = sce4$CD4_metacluster, 
                     CD4_metacluster_labelled = paste(sce4$CD4_metacluster, "CD4", sep="_"),
                     CD4_fine_cluster_labelled = paste(sce4$CD4_fine_cluster, "CD4", sep="_"),
                     GMM_CD4_combined = sce4$GMM_CD4_combined,
                     astir_CD4_combined = sce4$astir_CD4_combined)

CD8_subset <- tibble(cell_id = sce8$cell_id, 
                      CD8_metacluster = sce8$CD8_metacluster, 
                      CD8_metacluster_labelled = paste(sce8$CD8_metacluster, "CD8", sep="_"), 
                      CD8_fine_cluster_labelled = paste(sce8$CD8_fine_cluster, "CD8", sep="_"),
                     GMM_CD8_combined = sce8$GMM_CD8_combined,
                     astir_CD8_combined = sce8$astir_CD8_combined)

sce_df <- sce_df %>%
    left_join(CD4_subset, by = "cell_id") %>%
    left_join(CD8_subset, by = "cell_id") %>%
    mutate(Tcell_metacluster = coalesce(CD4_metacluster_labelled, CD8_metacluster_labelled), # coalesce takes entry from column with non NA entry
           Tcell_fine_cluster = coalesce(CD4_fine_cluster_labelled, CD8_fine_cluster_labelled),
           Tcell_metacluster_combined= coalesce(CD4_metacluster_labelled, CD8_metacluster_labelled),
           GMM_Tcell_combined = coalesce(GMM_CD4_combined, GMM_CD8_combined),
           astir_Tcell_combined = coalesce(astir_CD4_combined, astir_CD8_combined))

## add to sce
sce$Tcell_metacluster <- sce_df$Tcell_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, sce_df$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_fine_cluster <- sce_df$Tcell_fine_cluster[match(sce$cell_id, sce_df$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_metacluster_combined <- sce_df$Tcell_metacluster_combined[match(sce$cell_id, sce_df$cell_id)]
sce$GMM_Tcell_combined <- sce_df$GMM_Tcell_combined
sce$astir_Tcell_combined <- sce_df$astir_Tcell_combined
```

## CD4

#### fine clusters

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce4$CD4_fine_cluster), sce4$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce4)[match(colnames(abundances), sce4$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```



```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}

# FDR at 0.05
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

# ## hierarchical clustering on logFC

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

## CD8

#### fine clusters

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce8$CD8_fine_cluster), sce8$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce8)[match(colnames(abundances), sce8$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```



```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}

# FDR at 0.05
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
```

## Complex fraction stacked barplot

```{r}
## PID Tcell_metacluster fraction dataframe
PID_Tcell_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(Tcell_metacluster,PID) %>% filter(!Tcell_metacluster %in% c("Unknown/Other_CD4", "Unknown/Other_CD8")) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_Tcell_metacluster <- PID_Tcell_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Perform hierarchical clustering on fractions
dd <- dist(cur_df, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order

# Define annotation dataframe
cur_df <- cur_df[row_sorted,]
anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, gender, age_bin, ISUP_combined, pT_combined,necrose) %>% unique()

# Plot annotation dataframe with ComplexHeatmap

  TC_fractions = anno_barplot(cur_df, gp=gpar(fill=metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_metacluster[!names(metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_metacluster) %in% c("Unknown/Other_CD4", "Unknown/Other_CD8")]),
                                   bar_width = 1,
                                   height = unit(25,"cm"),
                                   width = unit(11,"cm"),

  gender = anno_simple(anno$gender, col = metadata(sce)$colors$gender, border = TRUE),
                          age = anno_simple(anno$age_bin, col = metadata(sce)$colors$age_bin, border = TRUE),
                          grade = anno_simple(anno$ISUP_combined, col = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined, border = TRUE),
                          pT = anno_simple(anno$pT_combined, col=metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined, border=TRUE),

                          border = TRUE, 
                          #annotation_name_rot = 90,
                          gap = unit(1,"mm"),

# Create legends for annotation

             at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_metacluster),
             legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_metacluster))
```

## Fraction correlation 

```{r}
# METACLUSTER 

## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(Tcell_metacluster,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_metacluster <- SID_metacluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_metacluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_metacluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = Tcell_metacluster,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("Tcell_metacluster")
cor <- cor(SID, method = "spearman")
#cor[2] # only works for two images per patient 
n <- length(colnames(SID))
if(n > 1){
mean(cor[2:n,1])
}else{NA}
}

SID_metacluster_cor <- as.data.frame(SID_metacluster_cor) 
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- unique(colData(sce)$PID) 
SID_metacluster_cor$category <- "PID"
out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
SID_metacluster_cor$n_images <- out$n[match(SID_metacluster_cor$PID, out$PID)]

# Filter samples with 1 image only - Correlation = NA 
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(n_images > 1)

SID_metacluster_cor_plot <- ggplot(SID_metacluster_cor, aes(x = category, y = V1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = n_images), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 6))+
  ylab("Correlation of metacluster fractions per PID (n=2-6)")+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman rho = ",round(median(SID_metacluster_cor$V1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))

SID_metacluster_cor_plot

#CLUSTER 
## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)

SID_cluster <- SID_cluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_cluster_cor <- SID_cluster
SID_cluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_cluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_cluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_cluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = Tcell_fine_cluster, names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("Tcell_fine_cluster")

#cor[2] # only works for two images per patient

}else{NA}
}
```

## Dimensionality Reduction

separately for CD8 and CD4
```{r dim_red}
## Subsample 10% of cells from each core
#to save time and not get super crowded dimensionality reduction plots
set.seed(22)
sub_id <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub <- sce[,sub_id]

sce_sub8 <- sce_sub[,sce_sub$immune_metacluster=="CD8_T_cell"]
sce_sub4 <- sce_sub[,sce_sub$immune_metacluster=="CD4_T_cell"]

#Run UMAP/TSN
reducedDim(sce_sub, "UMAP") <- calculateUMAP(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$CD4_CD8,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 50,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
sce_sub <- runTSNE(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$CD4_CD8,], exprs_values = "min_max", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())

# CD8
reducedDim(sce_sub8, "UMAP") <- calculateUMAP(sce_sub8[rowData(sce_sub8)$CD8_cluster,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 5,exprs_values = "min_max", external_neighbors=FALSE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
sce_sub8 <- runTSNE(sce_sub8[rowData(sce_sub8)$CD8_cluster,], exprs_values = "min_max", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())

# CD4
reducedDim(sce_sub4, "UMAP") <- calculateUMAP(sce_sub4[rowData(sce_sub4)$CD4_cluster,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 5,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
sce_sub4 <- runTSNE(sce_sub4[rowData(sce_sub4)$CD4_cluster,], exprs_values = "min_max", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
```

## CATALYST-based visualization

MDS pseudobulk - MultiDimensional Scaling Pseudobulkk Analysis:
- Dimensionality reduction based on pseudobulk (Data aggregation within cell types) rather than on single cell level 
- MDS aims to represent the data in a lower-dimensional space while preserving the pairwise distances (or dissimilarities) between data points as accurately as possible

clrDR:
- Computes centered log-ratios on cluster/sample proportions across samples/clusters, and visualizes them in a lower-dimensional space (linear!), highlighting differences in composition between samples/clusters.
- PCA performed on clr transformed data


We will first convert the sce into a CATALYST-compatible format.

```{r CATALYST}
library(CATALYST)
# save spe in CATALYST-compatible object with renamed colData entries and 
# new metadata information
sce_cat <- sce
sce_cat$sample_id <- factor(sce$PID)
sce_cat$cluster_id <- factor(sce$Tcell_metacluster)

#add celltype information to metadata
metadata(sce_cat)$cluster_codes <- data.frame(Tcell_metacluster = factor(sce_cat$Tcell_metacluster))
```

```{r CATALYST pbmds and clrDR, message=FALSE}
# MDS pseudobulk 
## by Tcell_metacluster
pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "cluster_id", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$Tcell_cluster], # don't include CD4 and CD8a for dimensionalitr
      label_by = "cluster_id", k = "Tcell_metacluster") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$Tcell_metacluster)+
  theme_classic()

pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "cluster_id", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$Tcell_markers], # CD4 and CD8a inclused
      label_by = "cluster_id", k = "Tcell_metacluster") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$Tcell_metacluster)+
  theme_classic()

##  fine T cell_metacluster
cluster_ids <- as.character(unique(sce_cat$cluster_id))
shape_mapping <- setNames(
  ifelse(grepl("CD8$", cluster_ids), 16, 17), # 16 = circle, 17 = triangle
  cluster_ids
)


# CLR of patient proportions per myeloid_metacluster
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "cluster_id", k = "Tcell_fine_cluster", 
      label_by = "cluster_id", arrow_col = "PID", 
      point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$Tcell_fine_cluster, 
      arrows = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$Tcell_fine_cluster)+
  theme_classic()

### reset
sce_cat$cluster_id <- factor(sce$Tcell_metacluster)
metadata(sce_cat)$cluster_codes <- data.frame(Tcell_metacluster = factor(sce_cat$Tcell_metacluster))


# CLR of patient proportions per Tcell_metacluster
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "cluster_id", k = "Tcell_metacluster", 
      label_by = "cluster_id", arrow_col = "PID", 
      point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$Tcell_metacluster, 
      arrows = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_mapping) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_classic()


# CLR of Tcell_metacluster proportions per patient
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "sample_id", point_col = "sample_id",
      k = "Tcell_metacluster", point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$Tcell_metacluster)+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme_classic()


```

```{r}
## 04_broad
sce_broad <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_04_ccRCC.rds")

mat_broad <- rowData(sce_broad) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(type_markers, broad_cluster, use_astir) %>%
  mutate_all(~ as.integer(.))

colnames(mat_broad) <- c("GMM_broad", "FlowSOM_broad", "Astir_broad")

## 05_sub
sce_sub <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")

mat_sub <- rowData(sce_sub)%>% as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(sub_cluster, # PhenoGraph
                GMM_immune, # GMM
                use_astir_immune) %>% # astir
  mutate_all(~ as.integer(.))

colnames(mat_sub) <- c("PhenoGraph_sub", "GMM_sub", "Astir_sub")

## 06_Tcell
mat_CD4 <- rowData(sce4) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(CD4_cluster, use_astir_CD4, GMM_CD4) %>%
  mutate_all(~ as.integer(.))

colnames(mat_CD4) <- c("PhenoGraph_CD4", "Astir_CD4", "GMM_CD8")

mat_CD8 <- rowData(sce8) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(CD8_cluster, use_astir_CD8, GMM_CD8) %>%
  mutate_all(~ as.integer(.))

colnames(mat_CD8) <- c("PhenoGraph_CD8", "Astir_CD8", "GMM_CD8")


mat_out <- cbind(mat_broad, mat_sub, mat_CD4, mat_CD8)
mat_out <- mat_out[mat_out %>% rowSums() != 0,]

col_anno <- data.frame(
  marker_selection = colnames(mat_out),
  classification = ifelse(colnames(mat_out) %in% c("GMM_broad", "FlowSOM_broad", "Astir_broad"), "broad", 
                          ifelse(colnames(mat_out) %in% c("PhenoGraph_sub", "GMM_sub", "Astir_sub"), "sub", "T_cell"))
)

col_anno$classification <- factor(col_anno$classification, levels = c("broad", "sub", "T_cell"))

row_anno <- data.frame(
  markers = rownames(mat_out),
  category = ifelse(rownames(mat_out) %in% c("CA9", "panCK"), "tumor",
                    ifelse(rownames(mat_out) %in% rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$broad_cluster], "immune", "T_cell"))
)

row_anno$category <- factor(row_anno$category, levels = c("tumor", "immune", "T_cell"))

h_markers_used <- Heatmap(mat_out, col = c("#F7C5CC", "#CC313D"), 
                          name = "markers_used",
                          column_split = col_anno$classification,
                          row_split = row_anno$category,
                          cluster_rows = FALSE,
                          cluster_columns = FALSE)

```

```{r}
set.seed(22)

#Number of cells per Community
# prepare df
df <- table(sce_known$Tcell_community, as.character(sce_known$Tcell_metacluster))%>% as.data.frame.matrix()

# add n_cells in each community
df$ncells_community <- rowSums(df)


## kmeans
kmeans_result <- kmeans(as.matrix.data.frame(data), centers = 16) # adjurs
df$cluster <- kmeans_result$cluster

# add n_cells in each cluster
df_cluster <- df %>%  dplyr::select(-ncells_community) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame()
df_cluster$ncells_cluster <- rowSums(df_cluster)


df <- df %>% mutate(community = rownames(.))

df <- left_join(df, df_cluster[c("ncells_cluster", "cluster")], by = "cluster")

# add cluster to sce
sce_known$community_cluster <- df$cluster[match(sce_known$Tcell_community, df$community)]

# Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce_known) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(community_cluster,PID) %>% group_by(community_cluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(community_cluster) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("community_cluster")

df_cluster$n_PID <- n_PID$n_PID[match(df_cluster$cluster, rownames(n_PID))]
df_cluster$n_PID[is.na(df_cluster$n_PID)] <- "0"

df <- left_join(df, df_cluster[c("n_PID", "cluster")], by = "cluster")

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(n_cells_community = anno_barplot(df$ncells_community, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),
                             n_cells_cluster = anno_barplot(df$ncells_cluster, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),
                             n_PID = anno_barplot(df$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#015444", col = 1)),
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")
h_com <- Heatmap(data, 
        col = viridis(100), 
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        split = df$cluster,
        name = "metacluster")+
  Heatmap(scale(data), name= "scaled",clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2")+
  ha_meta

h_com <- draw(h_com)
row_order_h_com <- row_order(h_com)
```

### Visualization

#### Rich heatmap

Add Differential Abundance information

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(sce$Tcell_district_names[!is.na(sce$Tcell_district_names)], sce$PID[!is.na(sce$Tcell_district_names)])
abundances <- unclass(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_TD <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

Add log Rank Test result
```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_Tcell_district_names <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_Tcell_district_names <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Patient without any cell belonging to any of the Districts.
PID_Tcell_district_names <- na.omit(PID_Tcell_district_names)

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_district_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_known$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_known$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_known$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_known$PID)]

PID_part_of_Tcell_districts <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(!is.na(Tcell_district)) %>% pull(PID) %>% unique()

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% filter(PID %in% PID_part_of_Tcell_districts) %>% unique()

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  cur_surv[,x] <- Cox_df_mean[,x][match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = cur_surv)
  p_value <- 1 - pchisq(fit$chisq, length(fit$n) - 1) # log-rank test
  data.frame(group = x, p = p_value, obs_2 = fit$obs[2], exp_2 = fit$exp[2])
}


# Adjust p-values using BH
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

cur_surv_plot_TD <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.1, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out))

```

```{r}
set.seed(22)

sce_known <- sce[, !sce$Tcell_metacluster %in% c("Unknown/Other_CD8", "Unknown/Other_CD4")]

for_district <- prop.table(table(sce_known$Tcell_district_names, sce_known$Tcell_metacluster), margin = 1)
for_district_fine <- prop.table(table(sce_known$Tcell_district_names, as.character(sce_known$Tcell_fine_cluster)), margin = 1)


# Proportion of Tcell_metacluster per district
Tcell_metacluster <- colData(sce_known) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district_names,Tcell_metacluster) %>% group_by(Tcell_district_names) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

                            border = TRUE,
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,

                            which = "row")

# Number of cells and PID
n_PID <- colData(sce_known) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district_names,PID) %>% group_by(Tcell_district_names) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(Freq != 0) %>% group_by(Tcell_district_names) %>% count()

n_cell_id <- colData(sce_known) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district_names,cell_id) %>% group_by(Tcell_district_names) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(Freq != 0) %>% group_by(Tcell_district_names) %>% count()

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cell_id$n, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),
                             n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),
                             border = TRUE,
                             annotation_name_rot = 90,
                             gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                             which = "row")

# DA ANNOTATION
anno_DA <- as.data.frame(rownames(for_district))
colnames(anno_DA) <- "district_name"

## Define the categories you want to loop through
categories <- c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")

results <- foreach(category = categories, .combine = 'cbind') %do% {
  # subset
  subset_df <- DA_TD[DA_TD$category == category, ]
  
  if (category != "ISUP_combined") {rownames(subset_df) <- sub(".$", "", rownames(subset_df))} # the other categories contain an extra letter in the original df
  
  matching_indices <- match(anno_DA$district_name, rownames(subset_df))
  
  # Extract information
  anno_DA[[paste0(category, "_logFC")]] <- subset_df$logFC[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("result_", category)]] <- subset_df$result[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_", category)]] <- subset_df$FDR[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("pch_", category)]] <- ifelse(anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_",category)]] < 0.05, "*", NA) # mark significant logFC
  return(anno_DA[, c(paste0(category, "_logFC"), paste0("pch_", category), paste0("FDR_", category))])
}

anno_DA <- cbind(anno_DA, results)

anno_DA$split = apply(anno_DA, 1, function(row) {
  if ("UP" %in% row) {
    return("UP")
  } else if ("DOWN" %in% row) {
    return("DOWN")
  } else {
    return("NOTSIG")
  }
})

# specify color for logFC
# col_DA = colorRamp2(c(min(DA_TD$logFC), 0, max(DA_TD$logFC)), c("blue", "white", "red"))
col_palette <- brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")
breaks_seq <- c(
  seq(min(DA_TD$logFC), 0, length.out = 6)[-6], # 5 values up to but not including 0
  0,                                     # Middle value
  seq(0, max(DA_TD$logFC), length.out = 6)[-1]  # 5 values starting from 0 (excluding 0)
)
col_DA <- colorRamp2(breaks_seq, col_palette)

# HeatmapAnnotation
ha_DA <- HeatmapAnnotation(# Clinical categories - make anno_simple for each category in order to specify pch
                           ISUP_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$ISUP_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_ISUP_combined), 
                           pT_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$pT_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_pT_combined),
                           necrose = anno_simple(anno_DA$necrose_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_necrose),
                           PDL1_score = anno_simple(anno_DA$PDL1_score_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_PDL1_score),
                           
                           # row annotation
                           which = "row",
                           
                           # legend - only show 1 (how to change name from ISUP_combined to logFC?)
                           show_legend = c("pT_combined" = FALSE, "necrose" = FALSE, "PDL1_score" = FALSE))


# SURV ANNOTATION
## bring into right order
matching_indices <- match(rownames(for_district), cur_surv_plot_TD$group)
anno_surv <- cur_surv_plot_TD[matching_indices,]
anno_surv$pch <- ifelse(anno_surv$p_adj < 0.05, "*", NA) # mark significant logRank

## color for log10(FDR)
# col_surv<- colorRamp2(c(-4, 0, 4), c("darkgreen", "white", "magenta"))
col_palette <- brewer.pal(11, "PiYG")
breaks_seq <- c(
  seq(-4, 1, length.out = 6)[-6], # 5 values up to but not including 0
  1,                                     # Middle value
  seq(1, 4, length.out = 6)[-1]  # 5 values starting from 0 (excluding 0)
)
col_surv <- colorRamp2(breaks_seq, col_palette)


# HJeatmapAnnotation
ha_logRank <- HeatmapAnnotation(log10FDR = anno_simple(anno_surv$p_out, col = col_surv, pch = anno_surv$pch),
                                which = "row")

# Plot heatmap
h <- Heatmap(for_district, name= "fraction",col = viridis(100), row_names_side = "left", row_labels = rownames(Tcell_metacluster),
             row_split = anno_DA$split)+

# legends

              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce_known)$colors$Tcell_metacluster),
```

## Patient Groups based on T cell Districts

### Patient Group 1

Idea: Split Patients into +/- for specific T cell District. If patient has at least 1 cell of certain District it is +.

#### Assign Patient Group

```{r}
# "ctx_dom_CD8"
PID_D1 <- colData(sce_known) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district,PID) %>% filter(Tcell_district == "D_1") %>% group_by(PID) %>% count() %>% pull(PID)

sce_known$D1_category <- ifelse(sce_known$PID %in% PID_D1, "ctx_dom_CD8", "Not_D1")
```

#### Assess survival impact

```{r}

library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce_known) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, D2_category, D3_category, D4_category, D5_category, D6_category, D7_category, D8_category, D9_category, D10_category, D11_category, D12_category, D13_category, D14_category, D15_category, D16_category) %>% unique()

plot_list <- list()
plot_counter <- 1


for (category in colnames(cur_surv)[4:length(colnames(cur_surv))]) {
    cur_surv_category <- cur_surv[c("OS_months", "status_OS", category)]
    names(cur_surv_category)[3] <- "group"
    
    # Perform the survival fit using the renamed column
    fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ group, data = cur_surv_category)
    print(fit)
    
    # Plotting the survival curve
    surv_plot <- ggsurvplot(fit,
                            pval = TRUE,
                            risk.table = TRUE,
                            risk.table.col = "strata",
                            linetype = "strata",
                            surv.median.line = "hv",
                            ggtheme = theme_classic(),
                            palette = "Set1",
                            conf.int = TRUE)
    
    # Add the plot to the list
    plot_list[[plot_counter]] <- surv_plot$plot
    plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
}

plot_list

# Patient groups associated with worse survival:
# cxcl13_dom_CD8, ex_ctx_dom_CD8
```

# 8. Survival analysis 

## Cox hazard models

## Tcell fine clusters

CD8 fine clusters and CD4 fine clusters 

### Continious 

CD8
```{r cox}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster=="CD8_T_cell"]
cur_sce <- cur_sce[, !cur_sce$Tcell_fine_cluster %in% c("CD134_CD8")]

# CD8
PID_CD8_metacluster <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_fine_cluster,PID) %>% mutate(Tcell_fine_cluster = as.character(Tcell_fine_cluster)) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_CD8_metacluster <- PID_CD8_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_CD8_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_fine_cluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups %>% dplyr::select(c(
  # "CD134_CD8", 
  "CXCL13_high_CD8", "CXCL13_low_CD8", "CXCL13_medium_CD8", "GranB_low_CD8", "GranK_high_Tim-3_medium_CD8", "NKG2A_CD8", "Tim-3_high_GranB_high_GranK_CD279_LAG-3_CD8", "Tim-3_high_GranK_low_CD279_low_CD8", "Tim-3_low_CD8", "Tim-3_medium_CD8", "Tim-3_medium_CXCL13_medium_CD8", "Tim-3_medium_GranB_low_CD8", "Undefined_CD8", "CD45RA_low_CD8", "EOMES_high_Tbet_low_CD8", "GranB_high_GranK_low_CD8", "CD45RA_high_Tbet_low_GranB_low_CD8"))

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- cur_sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),cur_sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- cur_sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),cur_sce$PID)]

# Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(cur_sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),cur_sce$PID)])
# Cox_df$age <- cur_sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),cur_sce$PID)]
# Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(cur_sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),cur_sce$PID)])
# Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(cur_sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),cur_sce$PID)])


# change all colnames containing a "-" or "/"
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", names(Cox_df))
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", names(Cox_df))

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(-OS_months, -status_OS) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
# coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("CD8 fine clusters")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

```{r cox}
# Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(cur_sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),cur_sce$PID)])


# change all colnames containing a "-" or "/"
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", names(Cox_df))
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", names(Cox_df))

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-OS_months, -status_OS) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios

geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
# coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("CD4 fine clusters")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

### Mean / Median 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# CD8

cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster=="CD8_T_cell"]
# cur_sce <- cur_sce[, !cur_sce$Tcell_fine_cluster %in% c("CD134_CD8", "NKG2A_CD8")]

PID_CD8_metacluster <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(Tcell_fine_cluster,PID) %>% mutate(Tcell_fine_cluster = as.character(Tcell_fine_cluster))  %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_CD8_metacluster <- PID_CD8_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_CD8_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_fine_cluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

# PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

# change all colnames containing a "-" or "/"
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", names(Cox_df))
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", names(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- cur_sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- cur_sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(cur_sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- cur_sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)]
# Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(cur_sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(cur_sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(cur_sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean_fine_CD8 <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean_fine_CD8 <- ggplot(plot_df_mean_fine_CD8, aes(x = reorder(group, desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05)) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low), width = 0.2, size = 1) +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +  
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +  
  xlab("CD8 fine clusters") +  
  ylab("Hazard Ratio (HR) for con_mean") +  
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),  
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

hr_mean_fine_CD8

Cox_df_mean_fine_CD8 <- Cox_df_mean
```

```{r}
# CD8
cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster=="CD8_T_cell"]

names(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", names(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (GMM division of cluster proportions)
Cox_df_GMM <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
GMM_Cox <- Mclust(Cox_df[,i], G = 2)
as.character(GMM_Cox$classification)
}

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_GMM %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_GMM)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_GMM <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_GMM <- ggplot(plot_df_GMM, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("CD8 metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_GMM")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_GMM
```

## Tcell Metacluster

```{r cox}
# CD8
cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster=="CD8_T_cell"]
# cur_sce <- cur_sce[, !cur_sce$Tcell_metacluster %in% c("Activated-like_CD8", "Inhibitory-like_CD8")] # don't include due to the small n cell => CI veeery big

                                           "Activated-like_CD8",

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),

                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))

geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,10))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters labelled")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

### Mean / Median 

#### CD8

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# CD8
cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster=="CD8_T_cell"]
# cur_sce <- cur_sce[, !cur_sce$Tcell_metacluster %in% c("Activated-like_CD8", "Inhibitory-like_CD8")] # don't include due to the small cell number
# table(sce8$CD8_metacluster)

PID_Tcell_metacluster <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(Tcell_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_Tcell_metacluster <- PID_Tcell_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_Tcell_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

# change all colnames containing a "-" or "/"
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", names(Cox_df))
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", names(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- cur_sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- cur_sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(cur_sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- cur_sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(cur_sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(cur_sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(cur_sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),cur_sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean_meta_CD8 <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean_meta_CD8 <- ggplot(plot_df_mean_meta_CD8, aes(x = reorder(group, desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05)) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low)) +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +  
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +  
  xlab("CD8 Metaclusters") +  
  ylab("Hazard Ratio (HR) for con_mean") +  
  theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean_meta_CD8

Cox_df_mean_meta_CD8 <- Cox_df_mean
```

```{r}
# CD8
cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster=="CD8_T_cell"]
# cur_sce <- cur_sce[, !cur_sce$Tcell_metacluster %in% c("Activated-like_CD8", "Inhibitory-like_CD8")] # don't include due to the small cell number

PID_Tcell_metacluster <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_Tcell_metacluster <- PID_Tcell_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

names(Cox_df) <- gsub("-", "_", names(Cox_df))
names(Cox_df) <- gsub("/", "_", names(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (GMM division of cluster proportions)
Cox_df_GMM <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
GMM_Cox <- Mclust(Cox_df[,i], G = 2)
as.character(GMM_Cox$classification)
}

colnames(Cox_df_GMM) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_GMM) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_GMM <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_GMM,stringsAsFactors=TRUE)

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_GMM %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_GMM)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_GMM <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_GMM_CD8 <- ggplot(plot_df_GMM, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("CD8 Metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_GMM")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

```{r cox}
library(survival)
```

```{r}
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 15))

hr_mean_TD

Cox_df_mean_TD <- Cox_df_mean
```

### GMM

```{r}
PID_Tcell_district_names <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(Tcell_district_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_Tcell_district_names <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Patient doesn't have one cell belonging to any of the Districts.
PID_Tcell_district_names <- na.omit(PID_Tcell_district_names)

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_Tcell_district_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "Tcell_district_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

## Based on categories (GMM division of cluster proportions)
Cox_df_GMM <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
GMM_Cox <- Mclust(Cox_df[,i], G = 2)
as.character(GMM_Cox$classification)
}

colnames(Cox_df_GMM) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_GMM) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_GMM <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_GMM,stringsAsFactors=TRUE)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_GMM$status_OS <- sce_known$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce_known$PID)]
Cox_df_GMM$OS_months <- sce_known$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce_known$PID)]

#Cox_df_GMM$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_GMM$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_GMM$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_GMM$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_GMM %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_GMM)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_GMM <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_GMM <- ggplot(plot_df_GMM, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_GMM")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_GMM
```

### Cluster-level

#### CD4
```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique()

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_logrank_CD4_fine <- foreach(x = colnames(Cox_df_mean_fine_CD4 %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  cur_surv[,x] <- Cox_df_mean_fine_CD4[,x][match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean_fine_CD4))]
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = cur_surv)
  p_value <- 1 - pchisq(fit$chisq, length(fit$n) - 1)
  data.frame(group = x, p = p_value, obs_2 = fit$obs[2], exp_2 = fit$exp[2])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_logrank_CD4_fine$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_logrank_CD4_fine$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_logrank_CD4_fine %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.05, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out))

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(FDR)")
```
