# 9. Very Rich Complex Heatmaps

## CD8 fine cluster

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
### 1. Heatmap body ###

cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster == "CD8_T_cell"] # adjust

cur_sce$cluster_selected <- cur_sce$Tcell_fine_cluster  # adjust

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_cur_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(cur_sce, ids = cur_sce$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(cur_sce)$CD8_cluster)  # adjust

# Heatmap aside for CD4 & CD8 - Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_CD4_CD8 <- aggregateAcrossCells(cur_sce, ids = cur_sce$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(cur_sce)$CD4_CD8)  # show all markers
# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% dplyr::select(-cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster_selected = spatial$cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(cur_sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(cur_sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(cur_sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = anno_simple(spatial$area, col=metadata(cur_sce)$colors$area),
    eccentricity = anno_simple(spatial$eccentricity, col=metadata(cur_sce)$colors$eccentricity),

### 3. DA Annotation
anno_DA <- as.data.frame(rownames(anno)) # order
colnames(anno_DA) <- "cluster_name"

## Define the categories you want to loop through
categories <- c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")
# categories <- "ISUP_combined"

results <- foreach(category = categories, .combine = 'cbind') %do% {
  # subset
  subset_df <- DA_fine_CD8[DA_fine_CD8$category == category, ] #adjust
  
  if (category != "ISUP_combined") {rownames(subset_df) <- sub(".$", "", rownames(subset_df))} # the other categories contain an extra letter in the original df
  
  matching_indices <- match(anno_DA$cluster_name, rownames(subset_df))
  
  # Extract information
  anno_DA[[paste0(category, "_logFC")]] <- subset_df$logFC[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("result_", category)]] <- subset_df$result[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_", category)]] <- subset_df$FDR[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("pch_", category)]] <- ifelse(anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_",category)]] < 0.05, "*", NA) # mark significant logFC
  return(anno_DA[, c(paste0(category, "_logFC"), paste0("pch_", category), paste0("FDR_", category))])
}

anno_DA <- cbind(anno_DA, results)


# specify color for logFC
col_DA = colorRamp2(c(min(DA_fine_CD8$logFC), 0, max(DA_fine_CD8$logFC)), c("blue", "white", "red")) #adjust

# HeatmapAnnotation
ha_DA <- HeatmapAnnotation(# Clinical categories - make anno_simple for each category in order to specify pch
                           ISUP_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$ISUP_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_ISUP_combined), 
                           pT_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$pT_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_pT_combined),
                           necrose = anno_simple(anno_DA$necrose_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_necrose),
                           PDL1_score = anno_simple(anno_DA$PDL1_score_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_PDL1_score),
                           
                           # row annotation
                           which = "row",
                           
                           # legend - only show 1 (how to change name from ISUP_combined to logFC?)
                           show_legend = c("pT_combined" = FALSE, "necrose" = FALSE, "PDL1_score" = FALSE))

surv_df <- plot_df_mean_fine_CD8 #adjust

## Add missing rows in surv_df (clusters not used in survival analysis). Add 0 for all entries

new_rows <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = ncol(surv_df), nrow = sum(missing_rows)))
names(new_rows) <- names(surv_df)
new_rows[,] <- 1
new_rows$group <- init_df$cluster_name[missing_rows]
cur_df <- rbind(surv_df, new_rows)
rownames(cur_df) <- cur_df$group

## bring df into correct order
matching_indices <- match(init_df$cluster_name, cur_df$group)
anno_surv <- cur_df[matching_indices,]

## Add significance symbol
anno_surv$pch <- ifelse(anno_surv$p_value < 0.05, "+", NA) # mark significant HR

## color for log10(FDR)

# HeatmapAnnotatio

# logRank

## Add missing rows in surv_df (clusters not used in survival analysis). Add 0 for all entries

new_rows <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = ncol(surv_df), nrow = sum(missing_rows)))
names(new_rows) <- names(surv_df)
new_rows[,] <- 1
new_rows$group <- init_df$cluster_name[missing_rows]
cur_df <- rbind(surv_df, new_rows)
rownames(cur_df) <- cur_df$group

## bring df into correct order
matching_indices <- match(init_df$cluster_name, cur_df$group)
anno_surv <- cur_df[matching_indices,]

## Add significance symbol
anno_surv$pch <- ifelse(anno_surv$p_adj < 0.05 & !(anno_surv$group %in% new_rows$group), "*", NA) # mark significant logRank

## color for FDR

# HeatmapAnnotatio

                                which = "row")

colnames(anno_DA) <- "cluster_name"

## Prepare DA df
categories <- c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")

results <- foreach(category = categories, .combine = 'cbind') %do% {
  # subset
  subset_df <- DA_fine_CD4[DA_fine_CD4$category == category, ]

  if (category != "ISUP_combined") {rownames(subset_df) <- sub(".$", "", rownames(subset_df))} # the other categories contain an extra letter in the original df
  
  matching_indices <- match(anno_DA$cluster_name, rownames(subset_df))
  
  # Extract information
  anno_DA[[paste0(category, "_logFC")]] <- subset_df$logFC[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("result_", category)]] <- subset_df$result[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_", category)]] <- subset_df$FDR[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("pch_", category)]] <- ifelse(anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_",category)]] < 0.05, "*", NA) # mark significant logFC
  return(anno_DA[, c(paste0(category, "_logFC"), paste0("pch_", category), paste0("FDR_", category))])
}

anno_DA <- cbind(anno_DA, results)


# specify color for logFC
col_DA = colorRamp2(c(min(DA_fine_CD4$logFC), 0, max(DA_fine_CD4$logFC)), c("blue", "white", "red"))

# HeatmapAnnotation
ha_DA <- HeatmapAnnotation(# Clinical categories - make anno_simple for each category in order to specify pch
                           ISUP_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$ISUP_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_ISUP_combined), 
                           pT_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$pT_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_pT_combined),
                           necrose = anno_simple(anno_DA$necrose_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_necrose),
                           PDL1_score = anno_simple(anno_DA$PDL1_score_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_PDL1_score),
                           
                           # row annotation
                           which = "row",
                           
                           # legend - only show 1 (how to change name from ISUP_combined to logFC?)
                           show_legend = c("pT_combined" = FALSE, "necrose" = FALSE, "PDL1_score" = FALSE))

# SURV ANNOTATION
# COX

colnames(init_df) <- "cluster_name"
init_df$cluster_name <- gsub("-", "_", init_df$cluster_name) # change special characters to "_" to match names in surv_df

## color for log10(FDR)

# HeatmapAnnotatio

                                which = "row")

lgd_logrank <- Legend(title = "FDR", col_fun = col_logrank, title_position = "lefttop-rot")

### 3. DA Annotation
anno <- colData(mean_cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_selected) 
anno_DA <- anno # order
colnames(anno_DA) <- "cluster_name"

## Define the categories you want to loop through
categories <- c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")
# categories <- "ISUP_combined"

results <- foreach(category = categories, .combine = 'cbind') %do% {
  # subset
  subset_df <- DA_meta_CD4[DA_meta_CD4$category == category, ] #adjust
  
  if (category != "ISUP_combined") {rownames(subset_df) <- sub(".$", "", rownames(subset_df))} # the other categories contain an extra letter in the original df
  
  matching_indices <- match(anno_DA$cluster_name, rownames(subset_df))
  
  # Extract information
  anno_DA[[paste0(category, "_logFC")]] <- subset_df$logFC[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("result_", category)]] <- subset_df$result[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_", category)]] <- subset_df$FDR[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("pch_", category)]] <- ifelse(anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_",category)]] < 0.05, "*", NA) # mark significant logFC
  return(anno_DA[, c(paste0(category, "_logFC"), paste0("pch_", category), paste0("FDR_", category))])
}

anno_DA <- cbind(anno_DA, results)

## define rowsplit based on DA result
anno_DA$split = apply(anno_DA, 1, function(row) {
  if ("UP" %in% row) {
    return("UP")
  } else if ("DOWN" %in% row) {
    return("DOWN")
  } else {
    return("NOTSIG")
  }
})

  ha_DA+
  ha_surv+
  ha_logrank

# legends
lgd1 <- Legend(title = "Metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce_known)$colors$Tcell_metacluster),
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce_known)$colors$Tcell_metacluster),
              title_position = "lefttop-rot")

lgd_sig_FDR = Legend(pch = "*", type = "points", labels = "FDR < 0.05")
lgd_sig_FDR_2 = Legend(pch = "°", type = "points", labels = "FDR < 0.1")
lgd_sig_p = Legend(pch = "*+", type = "points", labels = "p-value < 0.05")

lgd_DA <- Legend(title = "logFC", col_fun = col_DA, title_position = "lefttop-rot")
lgd_surv <- Legend(title = "HR", col_fun = col_surv, title_position = "lefttop-rot")
lgd_logrank <- Legend(title = "FDR", col_fun = col_logrank, title_position = "lefttop-rot")

draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd1, lgd_sig_FDR, lgd_sig_FDR_2,lgd_sig_p, lgd_DA, lgd_surv, lgd_logrank),legend_grouping = "original")
```
